comments.value:
Same situation.
The list of uploaded worlds that should be visible from social is not displayed.
The world data has not been lost because it is still visible in the menu of the previous version which is not in open beta.
I tried it on another PC and it is the same, so I don't think it is from my personal environment.
We're having trouble reproducing this issue. It might be a pain, but if you have an alt account with uploaded content, can you give it a shot there and see if it still happens?

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: 
Sure thing! I have also sent a support ticket with logs attached in my email for my main account incase that helps you out! 
Ticket number: #126072

I logged into my other account a̶n̶d̶ ̶a̶m̶ ̶s̶t̶i̶l̶l̶ ̶f̶a̶c̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶s̶a̶m̶e̶ ̶b̶u̶g̶.̶
EDIT: The api updated and is now showing the uploaded worlds on the alt. Switching back to my main account "rollthered" however still has no uploaded worlds tab.
Testing on multiple devices (Laptop to my PC) produces the same results. Uploaded worlds tab missing, no matter the device. This seems like an account issue serverside.
Also another note: The old QM (before the UI overhaul) was showing uploaded worlds, but switching to the beta branch when it was still around had it missing.
Still having issues reproducing this, unfortunately!

We've made a change to address this. Please respond to this message to confirm if this issue is fixed or still occurring for you.
Edit: Unfortunately, it seems it did not. We will continue to look into this.

@{5b12d42e9ad122540bc69858|full_name}: The problem remains the same.
I switched to open beta and tried logging out, etc. with no improvement.
VRChat has been updated to I confirm that the problem has been resolved.
@{5b12d42e9ad122540bc69858|full_name}: I logged on last night and noticed my uploaded worlds tab was there! It might be fixed now? Will update you on this if it disappears again.
We believe this issue is now completely resolved, please let me know if this is not the case, either by replying here or opening a new ticket.
